composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-00. It accepts exact integer offset in -4..5 inclusive (rejecting bool/float/missing/null), returning {accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}. The helper receives the whole inputs mapping so missing and null are distinguished; module scope invokes it and assigns its returned object to result. No imports, I/O or host calls. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation occurred; typed inputs require selected-runner support.

payload.name: pc-transfer-00
payload.description: Raw offset may omit or contain any JSON value. Accept exact integer -4..5 inclusive (not bool/float). Always result={accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. Target typed inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
